thread:
tess: Planning a base-image rebuild + KMS rotate next Fri 01:00 UTC. Main constraint: customer HSM keys block userland calls. Proposing a tiny signing agent (pod) that performs KMS:Sign on behalf of cosign. Need RBAC split, webhook guard, audit fields, and a tested rollback playbook. cc @harry @zara
harry: Agree. Minimal principle: builder SA = build/push only. signer SA = allowed kms:Sign on specific key version. signing-agent SA token via tokenRequest TTL=1h. No builder access to secret objects or KMS.
zara: Audit: signing-agent must log JSON-lines with keys: op, key_version, signer_principal, pod_uid, image_digest. Route to splunk index "images_audit" and to long-term audit store (prod 365d, staging 90d). Also include callerEmail in KMS logs mapping.
tess: OPA idea: webhook denies RoleBinding where subject.namespace == "builders" && role.rules contains "kms". Short pseudo: `deny[msg] { input.binding.subject.namespace == "builders"; some r; input.binding.role.rules[r].contains("kms") ; msg = "builders must not have KMS" }`
harry: Also add registry retention: protect last 40 signed tags per base image, mark protected tags immutable for 72h post-rotation. Prevent GC fallback images.
audit-bot: preflight: missing auditfield mapping for signer_principal -> recommend fluentd filter to extract `signer_principal` from JSON logs
oncall: set pager: cosign.verify.fail_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> page security-oncall
zara: Rollback (concise): 1) Abort rotation and block builds. 2) Re-enable previous key version. 3) Promote previous signed tags as current. 4) Run cluster-wide `cosign verify` job. 5) If verify fails -> escalate to incident channel and keep old images pinned. Owner: tess primary, harry backup.
tess: I'll open PR with RBAC + OPA webhook + signing-agent manifest and unit tests. Dry-run in staging first. Tagging security-review. :thumbsup:
